# Script to save dS tree when it is produced by the codeml output. If dS tree is not automatically produced (when running model=0 for example), use the code "extract_dS_trees.py". 



```{bash, eval=FALSE}
#!/bin/bash

#make sure you run it on your PAML/ directory
#loop through all subdirectories
for d in */; do
    #get the gene name from the directory name
    gene=$(basename "$d")

    #define file paths
    mlc_file="$d/${gene}_mlc"
    output_nwk="$d/${gene}_dS_tree.nwk"

    #process the file if it exists
    if [ -f "$mlc_file" ]; then
        awk '/dS tree:/{flag=1; next} flag{print; if (/;/) exit}' "$mlc_file" > "$output_nwk"
        echo "Extracted dS tree for $gene"
    else
        echo "Warning: $mlc_file not found. Skipping."
    fi
done

```
